QuestInfo.name: Scary Plot
QuestInfo.0: Le Tierre makes an urgent request. She is ghost white something really bad must have happened. Go speak with Le Tierre.
QuestInfo.1: Le Tierre tells you that she was working as the Vice President's secretary and found out that Anthony was planing to spread poison. She believes he is trying to get back at everyone for the votes they cast for the city counsel. Go eliminate #r#o2600425##k before Anthony can carry out his plans.
QuestInfo.2: You have eliminated #o2600425# before Anthony's plan to spread poison was carried out. Le Tierre said she will formally report this to Edelstein City Hall and follow up on Anthony's crimes.
